column3: The Hebrew specifies fathers’ houses and repeats the distribution of one staff for each house.
The Hebrew says one staff for the head of their fathers’ house.
The staff will blossom. The Hebrew does not add “constant” to the grumbling.
The Hebrew repeats one staff for each leader and describes the grouping by fathers’ houses.
The Hebrew calls them “sons of rebellion”.
The statement that Moses did so is repeated at the end.
The Hebrew verbs present expiring and perishing as completed events.
The Hebrew repeats the expression for drawing near.
